hero_subheadline: A boutique eco-retreat and garden bar in the heart of Ghana
experience_stay_body: Five boutique rooms tucked into 12 acres of managed forest garden. Each one designed to connect you with the land — without sacrificing comfort.
experience_bar_body: Open to guests and visitors alike. Seasonal Ghanaian food, fresh cocktails, and a terrace that catches the evening breeze.
coming_soon_body: We're putting the finishing touches on our booking system. Join the waitlist and we'll reach out first.
